items.lede: Data centers are deeply unpopular. But what if we called them something else?
items.title: OpenAI might rebrand its data centers as ‘AI compute campuses’

items.lede: OpenAI expects AI to become a major issue in the 2028 presidential election and is preparing a policy and public relations push after the U.S. midterm elections. The company is also promoting the term “AI compute campuses” for its data centers as it seeks to address concerns over electricity demand, water consumption, pollution and rising utility bills
items.title: OpenAI considers rebranding data centers to 'AI compute campuses" as data center backlash intensifies

items.lede: OpenAI’s Chris Lehane wants AI to define the 2028 election, proposing a new social contract that could benefit Americans while also advancing the AI giant’s own business interests.
items.title: OpenAI is already trying to shape the 2028 election
